title: CoT-Valve: Length-Compressible Chain-of-Thought Tuning
authors_zh: Xinyin Ma；Guangnian Wan；Runpeng Yu；Gongfan Fang；Xinchao Wang
paper_type_zh: Rollout、搜索或测试时推理轨迹研究
best_for_zh: 需要审计测试时 rollout、选择器、反馈信号和计算预算的读者
one_line: A released mixed-length CoT resource and tuning recipe for controllable reasoning compression.
CoT-Valve 使用 MixChain 中不同长度的推理链训练长度可压缩的 CoT，并把压缩与正确性筛选作为可审计的构造步骤。
why: It highlights that a short trace is not automatically auditable: filtering flags, source lineage, and compression decisions must accompany the text.
inclusion_reason: It highlights that a short trace is not automatically auditable: filtering flags, source lineage, and compression decisions must accompany the text.

title: Problem
问题
html: Long chain-of-thought can improve difficult reasoning but raises inference cost, and prompt-only length requests do not reliably produce a requested budget. CoT-Valve, published at ACL 2025, asks whether one model can expose a controllable long-to-short reasoning continuum without training a separate model for every length. For the atlas, the relevant data object is MixChain: each question is paired with multiple answer-bearing reasoning traces at different lengths, plus token counts and, in one released subset, answer-correctness flags. The decision boundary is therefore not merely whether shorter outputs score well, but whether the trace lineage, length-control parameter, correctness check, and retained failures are sufficient to reproduce or audit the compression recipe.

长链式思维可以帮助处理困难推理，但会增加推理成本，而仅在提示中指定长度也不能可靠地产生目标预算。发表于 ACL 2025 的 CoT-Valve 研究一个模型能否呈现可控的长到短推理连续体，而不必为每种长度分别训练模型。对本图谱而言，核心数据对象是 MixChain：同一问题对应多条不同长度且带最终答案的推理轨迹，并记录 token 数；其中一个已发布子集还带答案正确性标记。因此，判断边界不只是短输出是否取得较好分数，还包括轨迹血缘、长度控制参数、正确性检查和保留失败样本是否足以复现或审计压缩配方。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: CoT-Valve treats the parameter update between a long- and a short-reasoning model as a length-control direction. Scaling that update with an interpolation or extrapolation coefficient produces traces of different lengths for the same question, which are assembled into MixChain instead of relying only on repeated sampling or handwritten deletion. CoT-Valve++ trains with a normalized per-trace length factor so intermediate positions on the direction are supervised; CoT-Valve+P progressively trains on shorter traces rather than jumping directly to the shortest one. The feedback contract is answer-level: released PRM12K records expose Boolean correctness indicators for generated solutions, while the public schema does not expose step-level verifier labels. This makes the work relevant to the rollout/search/test-time-trace track as a long-to-short distillation and budget-control recipe, not as evidence that compressed traces are faithful reasoning.

CoT-Valve 将长推理模型与短推理模型之间的参数更新视为长度控制方向。通过插值或外推系数缩放该更新，可为同一问题产生不同长度的轨迹，再组装成 MixChain，而不是只依赖重复采样或人工删减。CoT-Valve++ 使用按轨迹归一化的长度因子进行训练，使该方向的中间位置也受到监督；CoT-Valve+P 则逐步使用更短轨迹训练，而非一次跳到最短轨迹。其反馈契约位于答案级：已发布的 PRM12K 记录为生成解提供 Boolean 正确性标记，但公开 schema 没有步骤级 verifier 标签。因此，该工作适合在 rollout/search/test-time-trace 轨道中作为 long-to-short 蒸馏与预算控制配方阅读，而不能据此认定压缩轨迹忠实反映推理。

title: Method
方法
html:
The paper describes two routes for obtaining the length direction. With annotated reasoning data such as GSM8K or the math portion of PRM800K, a model is fine-tuned toward shorter chains as a cold start. Without explicit explanations, the update between a base model and its corresponding reasoning model, such as LLaMA-3.1-8B versus DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B or Qwen-32B-Instruct versus QwQ-32B-Preview, is used as the direction. Varying its coefficient generates several solutions per question from short to long; CoT-Valve++ adds the normalized length factor during tuning, and CoT-Valve+P consumes successively shorter solutions.

The official Hugging Face collection exposes three datasets under Apache-2.0 labels. MixChain-Z-GSM8K has 6,863 questions and five solutions per record: the original answer, four generated solutions, their token counts, and an extracted target. MixChain-Z-PRM12K has 12,000 math questions and the same five-solution layout, plus correctness flags for the four generated solutions; its dataset card says it is unfiltered and retains incorrect solutions. MixChain-C-LIMO exposes two configurations with 474 and 564 question-solution records and reported average CoT lengths of 2,994.7 and 4,890.6 tokens. The public cards warn that generated solution lengths are not strictly monotonic. No official training code or complete sampling configuration was verified, and the exact answer extractor, seeds, parameter coefficients, model checkpoints used to generate every released row, and decontamination procedure remain unknown.

论文给出两种获得长度方向的路径。若有 GSM8K 或 PRM800K 数学部分这类带推理标注的数据，可先将模型微调到较短链，形成 cold start。若没有显式解释，则使用基础模型与其对应推理模型之间的更新作为方向，例如 LLaMA-3.1-8B 与 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B，或 Qwen-32B-Instruct 与 QwQ-32B-Preview。改变该方向的系数，会为同一问题生成由短到长的多条解；CoT-Valve++ 在微调时加入归一化长度因子，CoT-Valve+P 则依次使用更短的解。

官方 Hugging Face collection 发布了三个标注为 Apache-2.0 的数据集。MixChain-Z-GSM8K 包含 6,863 个问题，每条记录有五个解：原始答案、四个生成解、各自 token 数和提取的 target。MixChain-Z-PRM12K 包含 12,000 个数学问题，沿用五解结构，并为四个生成解提供正确性标记；其数据卡明确称数据未过滤并保留错误解。MixChain-C-LIMO 提供两个配置，分别有 474 和 564 条 question-solution 记录，报告的平均 CoT 长度为 2,994.7 和 4,890.6 tokens。公开数据卡同时提醒，生成解长度并不严格单调。未核实到官方训练代码或完整采样配置；用于每条发布记录的精确答案提取器、seed、参数系数、模型 checkpoint 与去污染流程仍为 unknown。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The paper reports that, for QwQ-32B-Preview on GSM8K, one CoT-Valve+P setting reduces the average trace from 741.1 to 225.5 tokens while accuracy changes from 95.1 to 94.9; on AIME24, a GSM8K-trained setting reports 4,629.6 tokens and 13/30 correct versus an Overthink baseline at 5,154.5 tokens and 13/30. Other tables cover LLaMA-3.2-1B, LLaMA-3.1-8B, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B, and a LIMO-trained Qwen model. These results support controllable compression under the reported models and evaluation settings. They do not show that every shortened trace preserves necessary reasoning, that correctness flags are error-free, or that the released mixtures are contamination-free. The official ACL record and the three author-owned Hugging Face datasets establish publication and partial data availability; they do not establish a fully reproducible generator.

论文报告，在 GSM8K 上对 QwQ-32B-Preview 使用一个 CoT-Valve+P 配置时，平均轨迹从 741.1 tokens 降至 225.5 tokens，准确率从 95.1 变为 94.9；在 AIME24 上，一个用 GSM8K 训练的配置为 4,629.6 tokens、13/30 正确，而 Overthink 基线为 5,154.5 tokens、13/30 正确。其他表格还覆盖 LLaMA-3.2-1B、LLaMA-3.1-8B、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B 和以 LIMO 训练的 Qwen 模型。这些结果支持在论文所报模型与评测配置下实现可控压缩，但不能证明每条缩短轨迹都保留必要推理、正确性标记无误，或已发布混合数据不存在污染。ACL 官方条目与三个作者名下 Hugging Face 数据集证明论文发表及部分数据可用，但不能证明生成器已经完整可复现。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier controls mainly specify a target length in the prompt, use summary tokens, repeatedly sample until different lengths appear, or prune text after generation. CoT-Valve instead locates a parameter-space direction associated with long-versus-short reasoning and uses coefficient arithmetic to generate multiple lengths from related model states. MixChain turns those controlled variants into same-question trace groups; CoT-Valve++ supervises intermediate coefficients, and CoT-Valve+P makes the data curriculum progressively shorter. The direction signal is useful because it links a data field, trace length, to a controllable model update and exposes paired alternatives for analysis. Parameter interpolation, LoRA, chain compression, and answer matching are not new by themselves, and the paper does not establish that length is a causal measure of reasoning quality or that the mechanism generalizes beyond the tested model relationships.

既有控制方法主要是在提示中指定目标长度、使用 summary tokens、重复采样直到出现不同长度，或在生成后裁剪文本。CoT-Valve 改为定位与长推理和短推理差异相关的参数空间方向，并通过系数运算从相关模型状态生成多种长度。MixChain 将这些受控变体组织为同题轨迹组；CoT-Valve++ 监督中间系数，CoT-Valve+P 则让数据课程逐步缩短。该方向信号的价值在于把轨迹长度这一数据字段连接到可控模型更新，并提供可供分析的成组替代轨迹。参数插值、LoRA、推理链压缩和答案匹配本身并非新方法；论文也没有证明长度是推理质量的因果指标，或该机制能推广到所测模型关系之外。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The paper states that extreme compression can reduce accuracy, especially on complex tasks; the method is bounded by the original model's ability to produce useful reasoning, and its parameter-space mechanism lacks a complete theoretical interpretation. The released PRM12K subset intentionally retains incorrect solutions, while length ordering is not always monotonic. The LIMO release has a different, smaller schema than the GSM8K and PRM12K releases. Exact generation coefficients, prompts, seeds, checkpoints, answer-normalization rules, split construction, source-license propagation, and decontamination are not fully disclosed in the verified artifacts. There is no verified official training-code release. Accuracy-token trade-offs and model-based step scores are evaluation evidence, not proof that the released reasoning traces are faithful, minimal, or safe to reuse.

论文明确指出，极端压缩会降低准确率，尤其影响复杂任务；方法还受原始模型生成有效推理能力的限制，其参数空间机制缺少完整理论解释。已发布的 PRM12K 子集有意保留错误解，而长度顺序也并非始终单调。LIMO 发布物的 schema 与 GSM8K、PRM12K 不同且规模更小。已核实 artifact 未完整披露精确生成系数、提示、seed、checkpoint、答案归一化规则、split 构造、源许可证传递与去污染。未核实到官方训练代码发布。准确率与 token 的权衡以及模型给出的步骤分数属于评测证据，不能证明所发布推理轨迹忠实、最简或可安全复用。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: For the rollout/search/test-time-trace track, CoT-Valve is useful as a long-to-short distillation case where several traces for one prompt share an intended answer but differ in budget. A reusable training record should retain the source question and license, base and reasoning checkpoint identifiers, interpolation or extrapolation coefficient, generation prompt and seed, every candidate trace, token count, extracted answer, correctness result and checker version, and whether the row was retained despite failure. This supports SFT, progressive compression, budget-conditioned evaluation, and audits of whether shorter traces omit essential steps. Builders should keep answer correctness, step validity, and token efficiency as separate fields rather than selecting the shortest correct-looking trace as an automatic quality label.

对 rollout/search/test-time-trace 轨道而言，CoT-Valve 是一个 long-to-short 蒸馏案例：同一提示对应多条目标答案相同但预算不同的轨迹。可复用训练记录应保留源问题及许可证、基础模型与推理模型 checkpoint 标识、插值或外推系数、生成提示与 seed、全部候选轨迹、token 数、提取答案、正确性结果与 checker 版本，以及记录是否在失败时仍被保留。这样的 schema 可支持 SFT、渐进压缩、预算条件评测，以及短轨迹是否遗漏关键步骤的审计。构建者应把答案正确、步骤有效和 token 效率保留为不同字段，不能把最短且看似正确的轨迹自动当作质量标签。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• CoT-Valve controls chain length through a scaled parameter update rather than a length-only prompt.
  • MixChain groups several different-length solutions under the same question.
  • The official collection releases GSM8K, PRM12K, and LIMO variants under Apache-2.0 labels.
  • PRM12K retains incorrect solutions and exposes answer-correctness flags; it is not a fully filtered corpus.
  • Token and benchmark gains do not prove step faithfulness or release reproducibility.

• CoT-Valve 通过缩放参数更新控制推理链长度，而非只在提示中写长度。
  • MixChain 为同一问题组织多条不同长度的解。
  • 官方 collection 以 Apache-2.0 标记发布 GSM8K、PRM12K 和 LIMO 变体。
  • PRM12K 保留错误解并提供答案正确性标记，不是完全过滤后的语料。
  • token 与 benchmark 改善不能证明步骤忠实或发布配方可复现。
